name: check_deviation
description:
Checks one requirement of a controlling document (instructions, a term sheet, a playbook) against the documents under review, part by part: conform, deviate or omitted, with a severity and a correction. The requirement is the controlling document's own words, quoted verbatim from requirementDocId (one of controllingDocIds) and verified like any quote; a paraphrase is refused with the closest passage to quote instead. Go reads the requirement in its context (the paragraph or list item that holds it, the introductions that govern it and its heading): the subagent judges against that context, its controlling quote must lie in it, and each finding quotes it. Each deviation must quote both sides verbatim; an omission is kept only when the provision does not verify in the named reviewed document (string match, then the paraphrase judge on its closest passage). Values in a correction must come from the quotes (or simple sums and differences of them); others are withheld and flagged. It returns the resulting finding ids. Do not use it for facts in one document (extract_facts) or for numeric conflicts across documents (join_discrepancies).
Example: {"requirement": "The residuary estate shall be divided equally among the three children.", "requirementDocId": "3f6c2a9e-0b1d-4c2e-9a7f-5d8e1b2c4a6f", "controllingDocIds": ["3f6c2a9e-0b1d-4c2e-9a7f-5d8e1b2c4a6f"], "reviewedDocIds": ["7a1b2c3d-4e5f-4a6b-8c7d-9e0f1a2b3c4d"], "issueId": "I4"}
